name: Northern Lights LCO2 carrier fleet (Northern Pioneer, Pathfinder, Liaison, Phoenix)
description: four 7,500 m3 liquefied-CO2 carriers (two full-pressure C-type tanks each, 130 m length); first three delivered from late 2024, fourth arrived July 2026 completing the phase-one fleet; further four 7,500 m3 ships chartered from K Line, scaling to larger vessels

sources.note: gCaptain (three delivered since late 2024); offshore-energy.biz 29 Jul 2026 (fourth arrived from China, 7,500 m3 each); norlights.com (7,500 m3, 130 m); read 2026-10-28
